messages:
maya: FYI — we're getting multiple support/sales asks that overlap around tenant-level rate limiting and per-tenant visibility. I think we should consolidate into one canonical backlog item and notify requesters.

omar: Confirmed — I pulled three tickets: SUPPORT-5243, SUPPORT-5271, SUPPORT-5310. All ask for per-tenant limits + console visibility. A couple mention webhook notifications for thresholds.

lina: Acme (sales) is asking for an ETA — they need a mitigation by end of Q2 or we'll lose momentum.

raj: Proposed split to reduce risk: (A) Controls + minimal UI to set per-tenant limits (fast path), (B) Alerting/webhooks + audit logs (phase 2). Rough dev estimate: A = ~2w eng + 1w QA, B = ~3–4w.

emma: Workflow suggestion: 1) create a canonical ticket and tag with `customer-intake/canonical`, 2) link all related support tickets, 3) assign an owner, 4) pick incremental acceptance criteria, 5) notify requesters with a short status template. Feature-flag rollout recommended.

maya: I'll create the canonical Jira. Draft template I will use: 
```
Summary: Tenant-level rate limits + per-tenant visibility (Canonical)
Description: Consolidate support/sales asks for per-tenant rate limiting, console usage visibility, and alerting. Linked tickets: SUPPORT-5243, SUPPORT-5271, SUPPORT-5310
Acceptance criteria:
- UI to set tenant-level limit and save
- API to read/write tenant limits
- Console shows usage per tenant (top-level metrics)
- Rollout via feature flag with canary
```

omar: pls add SUPPORT-5310 to the linked list too (mentioned above).

maya: Done — created REDWOOD-1234 and linked the support tickets. Owner: @raj. Status: triage. :thumbsup:

lina: Can we send a short status update to requesters today? I can draft the message.

maya: Yes — suggested text: "We're consolidating your asks into REDWOOD-1234; initial scope aims for a Q2 mitigation (controls + UI); we'll follow up with ETA and a canary plan." Please tag requesters in the send.

dennis-bot: Reminder: add `customer-impact` label, and if we surface tenant-level logs make sure privacy review is flagged.

raj: I'll post an implementation breakdown and ETA by EOD tomorrow. Planning to split tasks into: API, UI, DB schema + migrations, rollout/flag.

emma: Agree on incremental approach. I'll create subtask owners for QA and rollout.

maya: Next steps recap: (1) Raj posts ETA + task breakdown, (2) Omar confirms all related tickets are linked, (3) Lina sends the customer note, (4) Maya closes the loop in #support.

omar: Confirmed — all tickets linked on REDWOOD-1234. I'll follow up after Lina's message goes out.

lina: Drafted and sent to Acme + BigCorp. Waiting for replies; will CC product on responses.

maya: Moving conversation to the canonical Jira (REDWOOD-1234). Reopen here only if blocker or new ask. :eyes:
